# Package `crypto/hmac`

```go
package hmac
```

Package hmac implements the Keyed-Hash Message Authentication Code (HMAC) as defined in U.S. Federal Information Processing Standards Publication 198.

## Index

- [func Equal](#func-equal)
- [func New](#func-new)

## Functions

### func Equal

```go
func Equal(mac1, mac2 []byte) bool
```

Equal compares two message authentication codes without leaking the index of the first different byte through an early return.

### func New

```go
func New(h func() hash.Hash, key []byte) hash.Hash
```

New returns a new HMAC hash using the given hash constructor and key. New panics when the constructor returns hashes with inconsistent sizes.
